notes: Counts are participants with any major bleeding event, not episodes. Registry result group OG000 is TICAGRELOR and OG001 is CLOPIDOGREL; groupId links the quoted counts and denominators to these labels. Percentages are printed in doc_records_pmid_19717846.txt: "ticagrelor and clopidogrel groups (11.6% and 11.2%, respectively; P=0.43)"; they were not used to calculate counts or denominators. The registry full randomized analysis set for efficacy outcomes is 9333 and 9291, respectively, but the selected bleeding outcome uses the safety set. Other bleeding outcomes (ticagrelor, clopidogrel) are non-CABG major bleeding 362, 306 (abstract rates 4.5%, 3.8%); major or minor bleeding 1339, 1215; non-procedural major bleeding 235, 180, all using safety denominators 9235, 9186. CABG major bleeding is 619, 654 and CABG major fatal/life-threatening bleeding is 329, 341, with CABG subgroup denominators 770, 814. These are distinct outcomes or populations and were not substituted for overall major bleeding.
